firm.instruct: firm, resolute delivery, emphatic and direct, rising conviction
firm.sample_text: Air abolishes the exit. The wealthy family breathes the same poison as the street vendor outside its gate.

grave.instruct: grave, somber delivery, slow and heavy, as if delivering an urgent warning
grave.sample_text: One point seven million deaths a year. That is more than a pandemic, sustained every single year.

somber.sample_text: Delhi residents lose about eight years of life expectancy to this air.

urgent.instruct: urgent, pressing delivery, faster pace, rising alarm
urgent.sample_text: Delhi recorded zero good air days in 2025. This is not a season, this is an emergency.

air_analyst.name: Air Analyst
air_analyst.personality: calm, authoritative documentary narrator, clear measured delivery, low steady pitch, serious but warm undertone
